set.body:
FOLLOW-UP (T4) found while sealing StructuralCoverage (bd-01M17ZNXY6AS1CMBQJRH3JMNVX).

NodeSummary.apply (align/source.scala ~304) does not check level. SourceView is an open trait, so a view may carry a negative-level node. Today this is caught only downstream: AlignWire.coverageOk refuses level < 0 inside CostBreakdown, and mappingsource.scala:215 has its own n.level < 0 check. StructuralCoverage therefore deliberately does not hold level >= 0 (source.scala doc); it holds only the count relation.

Link reached: permits. Reachability through the public producers (StorySourceView, InMemorySourceView) has not been measured.

Acceptance:
- Measure whether any public producer can emit level < 0.
- If one can, give NodeSummary a checked factory, or state the range in the SourceView contract and refuse it at view construction, with a failing witness first.
set.title: [follow-up] align: NodeSummary admits a negative level; SourceView cannot promise level >= 0
